# name: set-stereoinv-continuous-test
# technique: test fallback (test_fallback recipe): instances the kernel checks, chosen by hand
# goal: sage_test KaluzaKlein.Sets.Homeomorphism.stereoInv_continuous
# description: the claim at the instances below, each proved independently of the claim
SEED = 0
CASES = [
    (['1', '(by norm_num)'], True, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r), Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ![2 * q.1 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), 2 * q.2 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 - r) / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r)]) := by
  intro r hr
  have h : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r ≠ 0 := fun q => by positivity
  refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
    exact Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) h
exact @key (1) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r), Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ![2 * q.1 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), 2 * q.2 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 - r) / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r)]) := by
  intro r hr
  have h : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r ≠ 0 := fun q => by positivity
  refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
    exact Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) h
exact @key (2) ((by norm_num))'),
    (['1/2', '(by norm_num)'], False, 'have key : ∀ (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r), Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => ![2 * q.1 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), 2 * q.2 / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r), (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 - r) / (q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r)]) := by
  intro r hr
  have h : ∀ q : ℝ × ℝ, q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2 + r ≠ 0 := fun q => by positivity
  refine continuous_pi fun i => ?_
  fin_cases i <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.reduceFinMk, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
    exact Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) h
exact @key (1/2) ((by norm_num))'),
]
instances = [kernel_instance(*values, proof=proof, edge=edge) for values, edge, proof in CASES]
